record.field: "${object.company_id.name | safe}" <${(object.company_id.email or user.company_id.email or user.email or 'noreply@yourcompany.com') | safe}>
Sent to the employee when their shift is published.

field.name: body_html

div.style: margin: 0px; padding: 0px; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;

field.div:
Hello ${object.employee_id.name or 'Employee'},
A shift has been scheduled ${object.employee_id and 'for you' or ''}:
Role: ${object.role_id.name or 'N/A'}
% set start_time = format_datetime(object.start_datetime, format='full', tz=object.employee_id.tz or 'UTC') % set end_time = format_datetime(object.end_datetime, format='HH:mm', tz=object.employee_id.tz or 'UTC') % set display_tz = object.employee_id.tz or 'UTC' Time: ${start_time} - ${end_time} (${display_tz})
Duration: ${'%.2f' % object.duration} hours
% if object.notes:
Notes from planner:
${object.notes}
% endif
You can view your full schedule online.
Regards,
${object.company_id.name or 'Your Planning Team'}
